text.title: 三块布上的水滴
text.situation:
玻璃后三块材料样本排开。一块多孔，旁边附有小孔特写。第二张照片沿布中的一根纤维展示其形态。录制测试中，水穿过可渗透样本，却留在覆膜样本上。水滴能渗入未经处理的织物，而不是只停在表面。最后一张标签指出合成材料中的一个组成成分。玛雅记下各样本遇水的表现，乔没有只凭外观猜测；光滑表面下也可能有不同结构。

乔：只看就能判断它可渗透吗？
工作人员：还要比较录制测试。
玛雅：标签列出一个成分。
工作人员：是的，它说的是材料的一部分，不是完整结构。

paragraphs.en: Three material samples lay behind the glass. One was porous, with a close-up of a pore beside it. A second photograph traced an individual fiber through a piece of cloth. In the recorded test, water passed through a permeable sample but stayed on the coated one. A drop could permeate the untreated fabric rather than remaining on its surface. The last label identified one constituent of the synthetic material. Maya wrote down what each sample did when water touched it. Jo resisted guessing from appearance alone; a smooth surface could hide a different structure underneath.

paragraphs.en:
Jo: Can I tell if it is permeable just by looking?
Attendant: Compare the recorded tests as well.
Maya: This label lists a constituent.
Attendant: Yes. It names part of the material, not its entire structure.

S04.G09.P03.function: Drops across three pieces of cloth
S04.G09.P03.cue: 说明什么渗入材料以及材料包含什么。
acceptableAnswers: 标签指出材料的一个成分。 最后一块是合成材料。

S04.G09.T01.function: Drops across three pieces of cloth
S04.G09.T01.cue: 夹克织物让水通过，描述这一性质。
